_comment: Read off the masjid's printed Salah Timetable 2027 (1448 - 1449 AH), page by
page, by eye from the rendered pages - not from the PDF's text layer the rows
were lifted from, so the two are independent. See year-2026.json for what
2027-08-13 is a Friday in high summer; 2027-08-14 is the Saturday after it, a
row whose Fajr jamaat is a ditto, so it proves dittos carry forward. 28 Mar
and 31 Oct are the clock-change days, the rows most easily misread.
